profiles.biography: Keresa Richardson represents House District 61 in Collin County. Her official Texas House biography identifies her as CEO of The Lawton Group, a Texas trades-service company spanning plumbing, HVAC, electrical, refrigeration and pest-control work. She draws on decades of entrepreneurship and highlights small-business and skilled-trades issues.

Ben Bumgarner serves House District 63 in southern Denton County. The official House biography lists prior service on the Flower Mound Town Council and as mayor pro tem, a degree from Austin College, and small-business ownership. The published 89th Legislature assignments include Environmental Regulation and Pensions, Investments and Financial Services.

Andy Hopper represents Texas House District 64, encompassing Wise County and part of Denton County. His official House biography records University of North Texas graduation in 2000, defense-industry software engineering, software-company ownership and service in the Texas State Guard beginning in 2014.
